integrationPolicy.commonRuntime: Preserve current main UI, server-action transport, tooling and lint rules; merge commerce extensions.
integrationPolicy.shopFeatures: Preserve storefront/admin code, schema and migrations, source assets, references, skills and tracked configuration.
integrationPolicy.auth: Use main server getMe to client hydrate boundary with shop authentication implementations.
integrationPolicy.configuration: Preserve shop settings as lazy getters following main.
integrationPolicy.bootstrap: Base app-setup/auth-setup and sample Storybook scaffolds are absent from shop because those features are implemented; active shop stories and main guidance are retained.
